owner: R09 notification audio; Android preview resources
changes: One existing Expo foreground notification handler remains the only audio owner; no media playback or separate vibration was introduced.
Stable event UUID deduplicates foreground retry across transport identifiers. Distinct subsequent messages remain eligible. Deduplication retains at most 1024 identities for the mounted runtime.
An 800ms burst gap limits audible cues while distinct allowed notifications remain eligible for list presentation.

Two device-local foreground sound preferences use AsyncStorage readback. Unknown/failed/pending settings suppress sound. Unknown writes reconcile by reading, with late-write fencing and synchronous-native-throw recovery.
Android default channel/permission are read on settings focus/foreground return; malformed values remain unconfirmed. Opening OS settings never claims settings were applied.
Three original synthesized short WAV assets are included through the Expo notification plugin for preview runtime r2 only. Active default channel/routing and production runtime/guard are unchanged.
Clock rollback resets the burst window without clearing event deduplication, preventing extended accidental silence after a device-time correction.

Installed Expo57 native builder couples foreground vibration to shouldPlaySound. Settings explicitly disclose that disabling foreground sound also suppresses that notification vibration; no separate haptic/player bypass is used.
